content.comment_body: Hello, I'm relatively new to [product_name], but previously I worked on some automation using [article_no]. Currently, I'm planning to automate my rolling shutters and noticed it is now possible to connect to [product_name] through the cloud. Does this mean I can access the device remotely via IoT? My distributor only offers the starter kit with the [product_name] ([article_no]) version, so I'm wondering if [product_name] [version_no] software will work with this device, specifically for cloud features. Thank you.

Your distributor supplied a starter kit that includes the previous [product_name] version and not the latest [product_name] [version_no]. However, the [product_name] [version_no] also supports cloud connectivity, but only through Amazon AWS Cloud. Additionally, the [product_name] [version_no] software is backward compatible, allowing you to program or edit all [product_name] devices.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers around compatibility and cloud features of [product_name] modules and related software versions. Users are mainly concerned about which versions support cloud connectivity, particularly IoT access and integration with various platforms. There's also uncertainty whether the latest [product_name] software supports older hardware modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward IoT and cloud connectivity across all current [product_name] modules, and compatibility between the newest [product_name] software and their devices. They also hope for broader cloud integration options beyond a single provider.
